title: events.rs: max_n parsed as u64 but state counters are i64 — negative counter causes s-0 event IDs
description: events.rs:397-402: the SSE event-ID coalescing loop parses state counters as u64 via n.parse::<u64>(). State counters are i64 everywhere else (parse_state_counter uses i64). If a counter ever goes negative (store bug, migration), parse::<u64>() fails silently, that token is excluded from max_n, max_n stays at 0, and every SSE event gets ID s-0. Every reconnecting client gets Last-Event-ID:s-0, causing perpetual full replays.
